results_seen_by_then: none in the gap or elsewhere in this part (only coverage and template counts, which read no result)
scored_rows: gap rows (td_date >= 2025-08-01, the model input BetOnline or the average per odds_input.construct) played before 2026-07-29 (tournament_date and td_date): 4,340 rows
primary: each candidate log loss minus BetOnline last line (today stand-in), paired on rows where both priced; mLL; 95% interval over four-week blocks (odds_sources common.mean_ci); P(better) = Phi(-est/SE). better/worse only when the interval clears 0, else unresolved

walk_forward_declared.rule: logistic without intercept on all earlier rows from 2018 where every member is priced, refitted at each four-week block, weights normalised to sum 1 (pools.weighted); a block is scored only with >= 500 training rows

pinnacle_proxy_declared.primary: OLS without intercept of reconciled Pinnacle log-odds on the priced subset of {bol,b365,avg,max,otmed}, one fit per pattern, fitted 2018-01-01..2025-07-31
variants: BetOnline alone rescaled to Pinnacle (bol only)
pinnacle_proxy_declared.checks: distance to Pinnacle (KL mLL, RMSE log-odds) walk-forward by season 2019-2025 and in the post-change window 2025-08-01..2025-09-07 (OddsTrader Pinnacle); results in the gap

full_coverage_rules_declared.proxy: the primary proxy (avg is one of its books, so it is always defined)

exploratory: every equal average of 2-4 of the 8 singles (154), ranked on even four-week blocks, confirmed on odd blocks
secondary: by part: 2025 (Aug-Nov, new against odds_sources s4) and 2026 (Jan-28 Jul, overlapping it)
calibration slope per candidate in the gap
Polymarket 60 min as a check on the 30-min price

additions.results_seen_by_then: odds_psx.py section 3 only: tennis-data PS against Pinnacle (OddsTrader), Pinnacle opening, BetOnline last and opening, Betfair, by period (2024-10..2025-07; 2025-08-01..09-07; 2025-09-08..2026-01). No other candidate scored in the gap.

added.b105: Bet105 last line (OddsTrader id 130), late lines dropped: the book nearest to Pinnacle own last line where Pinnacle is known after the August 2025 change (KL 0.20 mLL against BetOnline 0.39, 1 Aug - 7 Sep 2025; median |dz| 0.017; same price 23%) with 89% coverage of the gap rows. Selected on distance to Pinnacle, which reads no result.
added.b105_pre: the same, only lines stamped at or before the listed start (Bet105 last lines are stamped a median 0-6 min after it): a check against in-play prices
added.eq_bol+b105: equal average of BetOnline and Bet105
added.proxy_b105: the primary proxy with Bet105 as a sixth book (its pattern fitted on 2025-04..2025-07, the only months with both)
added.rule_b105: full-coverage rule: mean of priced {bol, b105} else avg
